direct_answer: Source identity and authored denominators are proven. Native Chrome and Safari render the Paper at desktop width, but Firefox is absent and no native 320/390 or true 200% zoom captures exist. Earlier exact-width Chrome/CDP evidence is proxy-only and shows overflow plus semantic defects. Public page and source routes emit no ETag, so conditional 304 behavior is absent from the exposed contract.

required_cells.width_390: partial proxy: Chrome/CDP clientWidth 390, scrollWidth 448, overflow 58 CSS px

inferences: Narrow overflow likely comes from long authored path or task tokens, but the exact native DOM offender was not isolated.
Unchanged source hash preserves content-denominator relevance, not old CSS or geometry proof.
Removing presentation semantics from authored tables and labelling callouts targets the clearest accessibility seam, subject to role verification.
recommended_repair_seams: In portable_doc/render/walk.ex, preserve authored data-table semantics and explicit header association for all 57 headers and 466 body cells.
Give all 13 ordinary callouts an appropriate tested role and accessible label.
Identify actual overflow nodes and prove native Chrome, Safari, and Firefox at 320/390 plus true 200% zoom without authored loss.
Extend revision-derived validators to flat and dataset-scoped Paper routes and prove exact 304 versus stale 200 behavior.
risks: Firefox, native 320/390 cells, true 200% zoom, real AT, and element-level overflow attribution remain unproven.
Conditional behavior is unproven across flat, dataset, and scoped routes and after revision change.
Proxy DPR emulation must never be promoted to true browser-zoom evidence.
unvisited_scope: native 320 and 390 CSS px in all three browsers
true 200% browser zoom in all three browsers
